{{Top|leg}}
In addition to the [[Imperial Engineers Academy]], the '''Institute of Starship Engineers''', also known as the ISE, was one of the top engineering institutes. A certificate of qualification from the ISE was recommended for anyone wanting to become a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]], as this certification was required for any engineers wishing to serve in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].

Those in the ISE were not mechanics, working with specific systems and subsystems, but as engineers they were far more concerned with the vessel itself, overseeing those mechanics who were needed to operate a starship.

The ISE was located on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] but had smaller facilities elsewhere in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]], [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]], and [[Perithal VI]]. There was also a campus on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] until the planet's [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]].

Registering with the ISE for one semester cost 15,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Imperial Credits]]. Eventually students would learn to design starships from nothing. Many previous students had sold their creations to [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] starship manufacturers. Full membership with the ISE allowed for more opportunities and career paths with self-made wages.

==Courses taught==
Courses taught at the Institute of Starship Engineers included:

*Hyper Space Engine Repair for Space [[Transport/Legends|Transports]]
*Hyper Space Engine Repair for [[Capital ship/Legends|Capital Ships]]
*[[Astrogation/Legends|Astrogation]]
*Computer Programming
*Computer Repair
*Capital Ship Gunnery Repair
